definition: Graphology is the study of handwriting as a form of motor expression that may be interpreted using psychological principles. In historical psychology, it also referred to attempts to infer personal character from handwriting, though this practical use was described as having weak scientific support, while handwriting changes in illness and disorder were treated as a legitimate area of study.
